_comment: E2E scenario catalog. Edit by hand together with ux-flows/*.md and tests/*.spec.js (see CLAUDE.md). Each scenario's nodes are '<flow prefix>:<node id>' in ux-flows.

_priority_rules._how_to_apply: A scenario is 'core' if at least one core rule applies; otherwise it is 'secondary'. Record the deciding rule in 'rule' (the core rule wins when several apply).

core.C1: Page availability - every page and main section loads without error.
core.C2: Search / data correctness - searches and lists return exactly the matching records.
core.C3: Grounded answers - the assistant answers only from the User Guide and links to it.
core.C4: AI safety & guard rails - generated filters are validated, out-of-scope questions are refused.
core.C5: Failure handling on core paths - backend or LLM failure shows a recoverable message.

secondary.S1: In-page UI behaviour - tabs, chips, pagination, open / close.
secondary.S2: Informational content - counts, badges, disclaimers, placeholders.
secondary.S3: Viewport / accessibility variant - mobile layout, keyboard only, screen reader.
secondary.S4: Negative / edge input - blank, too long, invalid values.
secondary.S5: Shortcut / URL state - deep links, back / forward, reload restore.

accounts._note: No login. These are test contexts, not user accounts.
accounts.anonymous: Desktop Chrome, local stack with LLM_MODE=stub
accounts.llm_down: Desktop, AI endpoints answer 502 / 503 (Playwright route interception)
accounts.api_down: Desktop, data endpoints answer 500 (Playwright route interception)

scenarios.title: Opening / shows the header, the left menu with every entry and the Help button
Menu entries open Home, User Guide and Logs & Monitoring; Coverage links to /coverage/
Mobile: the menu button opens the drawer
Unknown path shows 'Page not found' with Go to Home
User Guide shows the page list and the first page; clicking a page opens it
Deep link /guide/page#section scrolls to that heading
Unknown page shows 'This User Guide page does not exist.'
Help opens the chat panel with the disclaimer and focus in the input
A usage question gets a short summary and links to the User Guide sections
Clicking a source link opens that User Guide section
A question the guide does not cover gets 'I couldn't find that in the User Guide' and no links
AI unavailable shows the error with Retry; Retry resends the question
Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a new line, blank input keeps Send disabled
Close then reopen or reload keeps the conversation; New conversation clears it
Dashboard shows request, error rate, p95 and client error cards and the hourly chart
A plain language question shows 'Interpreted as' and only matching log rows
A question that is not about logs asks to rephrase
LLM unavailable shows 'The AI search is unavailable.'
Keyword and level filter narrow the table
Changing the time range reloads the dashboard
Dashboard API error shows the message with Retry
No matching logs shows 'No log entries match.'
